$comment: Rosette succulents (tools/content/env/plants.mjs rosetteMesh). Ground cover: decorative only (no collision, no concealment), placeable as a prop and painted by the environment brush. Stiff sword leaves in vertex colour (env.grass), barely swaying. One level of detail. See broadleaf.json for the fields.

notes.1: First version (Environment Phase 4, more variety, 2026-11-17): a rosette of stiff, thick sword leaves (0.75 m high, 1.5 m across), the outer ones spreading, the inner ones upright; arid and dry tropical ground. Decoration only (no collision, no concealment).
